text:
sam_app: Hey team — getting 400s from the rerank endpoint in prod since last deploy. Happens on large batches (~80-120). Example request and server error below.

alex_support: Can you paste the failing payload and the x-request-id header? Also which SDK/version?

sam_app: here's a redacted curl we used (we're on mobile-sdk v2.3.1):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'x-request-id: req-abc-1234' 
  -d '{"requests": {"items": {"id": "q-1", "candidates": "[\"a\",\"b\"]"}}}'
```

server log (from our gateway):
```
400 Bad Request - invalid type for `requests.items`: expected array, got object
request_id=req-abc-1234 route=/v1/rerank
```

jess_prod: thanks. Looks like the payload is wrapped oddly: `requests` should be an array of request objects (or `items` should be an array inside each request). That example has `requests` -> object -> items -> object, and `candidates` is stringified.

alex_support: @sam_app this matches a bug we saw with mobile-sdk v2 when batch size > 64 — the client bundler accidentally stringifies inner arrays during multipart serialization. Two quick asks: 1) can you repro with a synthetic curl where items and candidates are proper arrays? 2) can you share the raw HTTP body from the gateway (not the app-level wrapper) so we can confirm the SDK is doing the stringification?

sam_app: repro curl that succeeds (small batch):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"requests": [{"id": "q-1", "candidates": [{"id":"a","text":"A"},{"id":"b","text":"B"}], "top_k": 5}] }'
```

alex_support: perfect. So the fix is to ensure the client sends `requests` as an array and `candidates` as an array of objects (not a JSON string). Temporary workaround: patch the mobile bundler to avoid `JSON.stringify` on inner arrays, or post-process the body before send: `body.requests = JSON.parse(body.requests)` if the SDK wrapped it.

jess_prod: we'll add a clearer 400 message in the runtime: `invalid type for requests.items: expected array` -> include hint `did you stringify an array?` and link to docs. Also adding a log marker at `rerank.validatePayload` to capture request size and whether fields are strings.

alex_support: for immediate mitigation you can also set a gateway rule to reject payloads > 64 items with a friendly error to help customers until SDK patch is rolled out.

sam_app: thanks, will roll the workaround and try the SDK bump. Will follow up if we still see `req-abc-1234` 400s. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1987 — rerank 400 due to stringified inner arrays. Assigned to eng-runtime.

alex_support: assigning to eng-runtime / jess_prod for follow-up and a small runtime improvement. I'll keep this thread updated. :eyes:
